sections.Profile:
"Seven Up" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Williams Electronic Games, Inc. in December 1969. Designed by Steve Kordek, the game features a skiing theme, with artwork by Christian Marche. The playfield includes four flippers, four pop bumpers, two slingshots, six standup targets, and a single drop target positioned behind a rebound rubber. The add-a-ball version of this game is called "Set Up".
